shots.intent: 搜索列表首图，用一枚接收器配两枚夹式的立姿剪影赢一眼点击
一秒交代核心利益：夹在衣领就近拾音、无需配对即可录
用同屏三格铺开拍、佩戴、远距离隔空录的用法，完成身份代入
证明两枚夹机可隔空同录一台手机，把受众推向自用想象
用绒毛、肩线与充电口咬合微距证明做工与回充方式，参数留空
交底到手件数与配件形态，用空白标签框消除到手落差风险

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool porcelain #F4F6F7 for packshot and contents screens, soft mist blue-grey #CBD6DC studio fields for wear screens, pale slate interiors for scene screens, deep slate #26303A ground for the macro screen
style.direction: minimal creator-audio ecommerce, cool porcelain and clean
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip outlines in glacier cyan #4F8C96, no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused front-left key at 5500K with a cool bounce fill, one restrained rim sweep, gentle contact shadows, cool neutral grade, no harsh specular bursts
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal creator-audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool porcelain #F4F6F7, mist blue-grey #CBD6DC, deep slate #26303A and one glacier cyan accent #4F8C96; cool neutral lighting with a soft diffused front-left key at 5500K, a cool bounce fill, one restrained rim sweep and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip outlines only; matte charcoal product bodies with fine surface grain, one controlled specular roll and a single soft status dot; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic scaffolding; stable straight-on to slight 3/4 product scale and centring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no rendered in-image copy, badges, digits or model names
style.presentationRules: stable straight-on to slight 3/4 product scale, clip arm, button panel and plug edge always readable, never overlapped by props or hands
style.surfaceSystem: cool porcelain board #F4F6F7, washed greige linen #D8D4CC on the detail screen, deep slate #26303A macro ground
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held inside the style system only, every glyph area left blank for post-composited copy
